project.name: Gregg Family Relocation Scoring Matrix
project.purpose: Structured JSON scoring matrix for evaluating long-term relocation areas against Gregg's family, career, education, AI, robotics, fitness, tax, school, rental, and housing criteria.

user_profile_summary.name: Gregg
user_profile_summary.current_role: AI Marketing Specialist with Product Owner responsibilities at Sherwin-Williams
user_profile_summary.long_term_goal: AI Product Leader and eventual university instructor/professor in applied AI business after DBA and MSAI
interests: high school football as a lifestyle nice-to-have
user_profile_summary.preference_note: Virginia is the least favorite option.

planning_assumptions.rental_target: Professionally managed 3-bedroom townhome with a $2,600/month primary ceiling and a $2,900/month hard stretch cap (income-based; see rental_budget_config).
planning_assumptions.appreciation_assumption: 2–3% annual appreciation planning assumption based on the user's stated May 2026 consensus framing.
planning_assumptions.football_weighting_note: High school football culture is treated as a nice-to-have, not a hard requirement.

alternates.label: Private school scenario (income-contingent)
alternates.basis: Assumes household income supports private tuition at enrollment. Public school quality zeroed as a direct substitute.

alternates.label: Remote career scenario
alternates.basis: Assumes fully remote work: local AI/tech job-market proximity is down-weighted (25 -> 15) in favor of the home base - maker/robotics and fitness community, rental home quality, and university/teaching proximity.

criteria.label: AI / Tech Product Management Market
criteria.description: Strength of nearby AI, software, SaaS, cloud, data, product management, and executive AI leadership career opportunities.

criteria.label: Elite Public School District Fit
criteria.description: Likelihood of accessing strong public school zones, generally targeting 7/10+ GreatSchools or equivalent quality indicators.

criteria.label: Home Purchase Affordability by 2041
criteria.description: Fit against an estimated $820,000 long-term home budget by 2041, assuming broad 2–3% annual appreciation planning assumptions.

criteria.label: 2028 Rental Feasibility
criteria.description: Likelihood of finding professionally managed 3-bedroom townhome rentals near target schools and lifestyle nodes around or near the ~$2,200/month planning target.

criteria.label: State Income Tax Burden
criteria.description: Lower state income tax burden is better. No-income-tax states receive stronger scores, though property/insurance costs should be reviewed separately.

criteria.label: AACSB University / Future Teaching Proximity
criteria.description: Proximity to AACSB-accredited business schools and universities that may support Gregg's long-term goal of teaching applied AI in business.

criteria.label: Robotics, Fitness, Maker, and Indie Builder Lifestyle
criteria.description: Fit for robotics + AI interests, hardware/maker culture, fitness events such as running festivals and HYROX-style training, and indie builder/community opportunities.

criteria.label: High School Football Culture
criteria.description: Local high school football culture. This is intentionally treated as a nice-to-have lifestyle bonus, not a hard requirement.

locations.strategic_label: Fintech-PM career fit, motorsports engineering cluster, best Charlotte-metro 2041 affordability

private_school_option.basis: Contingent on income at time of enrollment

in_radius_options.notes: Top 100 at VEX World Championship out of 32,000+ teams. 65-acre campus on Poplar Tent Rd, inside the Cox Mill residential corridor - same target buy area, no commute compromise. Founded 1969 as Cabarrus Academy, a segregation academy; nonsectarian and coeducational today.

out_of_radius_options.name: Providence Day School
out_of_radius_options.excluded_reason: Beyond 20-mile radius; not commute-viable from Concord

private_school_option.assessment: Cannon School is an A+ anchor inside the target residential corridor, making Concord scenario-neutral: public (Cox Mill, 8.5) and private (Cannon, 8.5) score identically. The city does not require the private-school bet to be made correctly.

locations.notes: Charlotte is the #2 US banking center with ~82K finance/insurance workers and ~23K in fintech-specific roles. 2026 additions: Sumitomo Mitsui (up to 2,000 jobs), Citigroup Technology (510 jobs), Coinbase, JPMorgan, Schwab. Addressable sub-markets: Uptown core banking, South End fintech (AvidXchange, LendingTree, Passport, Brighthouse), Ballantyne/Fort Mill wealth platforms (LPL Financial). AI/PM score of 8.5 reflects Gregg's fintech PM background, not raw market size. Best 2041 purchase value in metro: median sold price $363K (2026) projects to ~$526K at 2.5%; Cox Mill Elementary zone averages $422,937 and projects to ~$613K, leaving ~$200K headroom under budget. Mechatronics cluster: GM Charlotte Technical Center (187+ staff, F1 program hiring), Hendrick Motorsports Technical Solutions (160K sqft advanced manufacturing HQ), NASCAR R&D Center, RFK Racing, Haas F1 in Kannapolis. UNC Charlotte Belk College (AACSB) ~15 min via I-85.

verified_communities.name: The Wayford at Concord
verified_communities.features: private garages, back patios, no shared floors
verified_communities.elementary_zone: Carl A. Furr (Niche B, #15 in Cabarrus)

disqualified.name: Redwood Concord / Redwood Kannapolis Parkway / Redwood Kannapolis Davidson
disqualified.reason: 2BR only across all three Cabarrus neighborhoods - no 3BR product exists

rental_phase_findings.note: SFH inventory in the Cox Mill zone clears the cap but is individually owned, not professionally managed. This is the tradeoff that lifted rental_feasibility from 7.0 to 8.5.

risks: SCORE VOLATILITY: moved 75.1 to 82.65 in a single session; three inputs came from user-supplied information rather than independent verification. Highest-variance entry in the matrix.
AI/PM market is domain-narrow - strong for fintech, thin for consumer product or AI research if career direction shifts
Corban Row elementary zone UNVERIFIED - located on Concord Pkwy S, outside the NW corridor where A-rated schools sit
Wayford at Concord is zoned to Carl A. Furr Elementary (B), NOT Cox Mill
ZONE TRAP: listings advertising 'Cox Mill High' may be zoned to W.R. Odell Elementary. Elementary is the only zone that matters for the 2028 rental phase (child age 0-2).
Concord city-wide CrimeGrade is C- (34th percentile); NW/W Concord materially better than central. Corban Row sub-zone unverified.
All BTR options exceed cap on total monthly price; Corban Row clears only on base rent, and 2028 escalation breaks it either way
